text: Honestly kind of lonely. I moved here for my PhD and everyone in my lab already has their people.
My roommate ate my leftovers again and then acted like it was no big deal.
Today was fine I guess. Went to class, came home, scrolled my phone for three hours.
I finally went to the climbing gym alone and someone asked me to belay them!
I miss my mom's cooking. Nothing here tastes like home.
I'm just boring, that's why nobody in my program invites me to things.
I'm going to skip the department mixer. Nobody will notice if I'm not there anyway.
I texted a classmate to get coffee and she hasn't replied in two hours, so she obviously hates me.
I'll start making friends next semester once things calm down.
Everyone here is fake, so there's no point trying.
Yeah. My apartment still has boxes everywhere and I don't really know anyone at work outside my small team.
Work was long today. I mostly just ate dinner and stared at the wall.
